name: Shinjou Sena
source:
Sena is Kureha's kind and gentle classmate who approached her on the day of her transfer. Because of his timid personality, he gets bullied.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.twofive.co.jp/hotokenser/chara/sena.html]official website[/URL].]
